build.reproduced: an independent rebuild of the same commit gave the same sha256 (franken_lean bead fln-elp6, comment 3082)

input.digest_algorithm: sha256 of the concatenated lines '<lowercase hex sha256 of the file>  <path relative to the root>\n', one per file ending in .olean, .olean.server or .olean.private, sorted by relative path

streams.stdout: the --json result, retained verbatim as v4.32.0.json

host_scheduling: this host runs ananicy-cpp, which gives every fln* process nice -4 (a higher scheduling priority under contention); the receipt's wall time is therefore specific to this host and its load, and is not a throughput figure
